author: whiteout
text:
Hi al, nice to see that now you can post pictures and charts. ok, about the chart you have posted...yeah you have got the idea, but the aim of the homework is not just spot them and draw some rectangle around them, is to understand that every Rally Base Drop - Drop Base Rally or Rally Base Rally - Drop Base Rally -is a decision point.

That's why you wonna find that point and then see how price have reacted to that later, becouse we are dealing whit decision point. Like all in life they have a different value, some are big important point other no etc etc.

Find a drop base rally, mark that area, and see what price have done the next time that price have visited that point and so on. hope that make sense. [sorry for bad eng]

ps: in this chart i have roughly marked just some of them, just to give you the idea..i can assure you that after you have spent some time on them you will see some complex story around every one of them.
